purpose: Preserve the first Campaign013 build failure as infrastructure evidence and authorize one exact retry that reuses hash-validated checkpoints without changing the frozen candidate, source fields, formula, direction, activity rules, support threshold, coverage gate, uniqueness catalog, or return boundary.

root_cause.inherited_manifest_phase: The Campaign006 checkpoint engine intentionally emits no source_amount_read field before the Campaign013 wrapper converts and publishes the final manifest.
root_cause.incorrect_campaign013_adapter: The first Campaign013 validator required source_amount_read=true in both the inherited prepublication phase and final Campaign013 phase.
root_cause.why_values_are_not_implicated: All 33015 partition computations and checkpoint writes completed. The rejection occurred only after aggregate manifest assembly, before final manifest write and publication, and no gate or comparison was evaluated.

repair.prepublication_rule: When require_fingerprint_constants=false, accept source_amount_read only as absent or true, matching the inherited engine's reconstructible manifest phase.
repair.final_publication_rule: When require_fingerprint_constants=true, continue to require source_amount_read=true together with the exact Campaign013 source field list and source_volume_read=true.

post_repair_formula_tests.added_regression: The inherited prepublication manifest with an absent source_amount_read flag validates only in the prepublication phase; final Campaign013 validation remains strict.
